mechanism: Polyethylene glycol-based formulations (such as PEG-lipid complexes) may alter amphotericin B distribution and pharmacokinetics, while both agents can contribute to electrolyte abnormalities and renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (particularly potassium and magnesium), and hydration status closely; ensure adequate spacing of administration when possible and maintain careful fluid/electrolyte management.
